lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You don't even know me. Why are you being so kind?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Kindness doesn't require certainty. Only choice.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: And what do you see in my future?

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: A storm you survive. Not because you are strong... but because someone will stand by your side.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: So, Frieda did work as a public seer... but instead of predicting destiny, she tried to give people courage.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: Not what i expected. Hmm, i should learn more about her
